ENV: all pinned infra versions published and installed exactly (aws-cdk-lib 2.272.0, aws-cdk 2.1144.0, constructs 10.8.1, tsx 4.23.15, esbuild 0.28.2, @aws-sdk/{client-dynamodb,lib-dynamodb} 3.1146.0, @types/node 22.20.5, vitest 5.0.3, typescript 5.9.3). `cdk init --generate-only` was used only to copy the current feature-flag `context` block into infra/cdk.json (app set to `npx tsx bin/kiro-man.ts`, notices:false, output:cdk.out); no scaffold files were kept.

LAMBDA CORE (infra/lambda): core.ts is SDK-free so every status is unit-tested from the root Vitest run (vitest.config.ts already globs infra/lambda/**). deps.replayOpts (tests only) is the only way to force replay_incomplete, since an honest default-config game always ends by MAX_TICKS; the deployed handler never sets it (I added replayOpts to the design.md `handle` signature to document this). Status mapping per LB-5/6 and overview §10: 413 (byte length after base64 decode, before JSON.parse) > 400 (bad JSON / schema details, logs field NAMES only, never the body) > 422 (replay_incomplete precedence over replay_mismatch, zero puts) > 201 (one put) ; GET → 200 top-10 run through ranking.normalize; non-GET/POST on /scores → 405; any other path incl. /scores/ → 404; store failure on read or write → 503 logged at error with the AWS error name. core.test.ts covers all of these incl. a GET that drops a bad-initials row and a 413 that counts bytes not characters; core.property.test.ts is P7-core (default config, fc logs maxLength 20, 120 s timeout, honest→201+1 put, dishonest→422+0 puts). dynamo-store.ts: single partition pk='GLOBAL', sk=zeroPad10(score)#createdAt#id, reverse Query+Limit for the top N, ConditionExpression attribute_not_exists(pk); only module importing @aws-sdk/*. scores-handler.ts maps the HTTP API v2 event (requestContext.http.method, rawPath, body, isBase64Encoded), caches deps across warm invocations, MAX_BODY_BYTES env parsed with a 131072 fallback. The bundled asset was smoke-run (handler on fake events) and returns the right 404/405/400/422; confirmed the golden route seed 0x4b49524f replays to score 400 level 1.

STACK (infra/lib/kiro-man-stack.ts, L2 only, header comment cites the power): HttpApi createDefaultStage:false + corsPreflight(*,GET/POST/OPTIONS,content-type) then addStage('DefaultStage',{stageName:'$default',autoDeploy,throttle rate 10 burst 20}). IMPORTANT: the stage construct id must NOT be 'Default' — CDK strips 'Default' path segments from logical IDs, which collides with the API's logical ID and throws SectionAlreadyContains at synth. I used 'DefaultStage' and updated design.md §Stage throttling to match. ANY /scores + ANY /{proxy+} share one HttpLambdaIntegration. NodejsFunction NODEJS_22_X, 1024 MB, 15 s, entry lambda/scores-handler.ts, projectRoot=repo root + depsLockFilePath=infra/package-lock.json so esbuild resolves ../../src/*, bundling {minify,sourceMap,target node22,externalModules ['@aws-sdk/*']}, explicit ScoresFnLogs LogGroup (1 week, DESTROY). table.grant(fn,'dynamodb:PutItem','dynamodb:Query') (least privilege, not grantReadWriteData — design said read/write, I narrowed it and noted it). S3 bucket BLOCK_ALL + enforceSSL + S3_MANAGED + autoDeleteObjects + DESTROY; CloudFront Distribution with S3BucketOrigin.withOriginAccessControl + REDIRECT_TO_HTTPS + defaultRootObject index.html. Conditional BucketDeployment when siteDir (../dist) exists, with Source.jsonData config.json {apiUrl: api.apiEndpoint} and its OWN LogGroup (1 week, DESTROY) — otherwise Annotations.addWarningV2 and synth still passes. Outputs ApiUrl/SiteUrl/TableName.

LOCAL ESBUILD GOTCHA: NodejsFunction local bundling runs `npx --no-install esbuild` with cwd = projectRoot (repo root), so esbuild must be resolvable from the ROOT, not just infra/. The root package.json did not list it, so the first synth failed with 'npx canceled ... esbuild@0.28.2'. Fixed by adding esbuild@0.28.2 to the ROOT devDependencies (exact) and committing root package-lock.json; documented in design.md §4.3. No Docker fallback.

STACK TEST (infra/test/stack.test.ts, 13 assertions): throttle 10/20 + $default + autoDeploy, exactly 2 routes / 1 integration both targeting it, CORS, DynamoDB PAY_PER_REQUEST + pk/sk + Delete, Lambda nodejs22.x/1024/15/env/LoggingConfig→ScoresFnLogs, every LogGroup 1 week + Delete, the IAM policy is exactly PutItem+Query on the table ARN, bucket private+encrypted+SSL-only (Deny aws:SecureTransport), CloudFront OAC + no legacy OAI + redirect-to-https, BucketDeployment present with config.json carrying the ApiEndpoint GetAtt (and absent + warning when no build), the three outputs, and stable logical IDs ScoresTable6CB35494 / SiteBucket397A1860. The test builds its App with the cdk.json feature-flag context so the asserted template equals the synthesized one.

POWER VALIDATION (docs/power-iac-validation.md + docs/cfn-lint-report.txt): the aws-infrastructure-as-code power's MCP server (awslabs.aws-iac-mcp-server 1.0.26 via its own `uvx ...@latest`, AWS creds removed) was driven over stdio with this repo's MCP SDK client (the power's tools were not attached to this agent session; recorded honestly). cdk_best_practices + three search_cdk_documentation queries informed the stack and are cited in its header. validate_cloudformation_template → is_valid:true, 0 errors, 3 W3005 warnings (CDK-emitted redundant DependsOn on auto-generated roles; justified). The reproducible CLI path `npm run cfn-lint` (scripts/cfn-lint.sh, uvx cfn-lint==1.57.1) matches those exactly and writes docs/cfn-lint-report.txt (cfn-guard CLI not installed → recorded as such). check_cloudformation_template_compliance (cfn-guard, bundled aws-security rules) → 7 findings, all on the static-site bucket / its policy / the CDK BucketDeployment role, each justified in the doc: 2 are false positives (SSL_REQUESTS_ONLY — the Deny statement IS present, Guard just can't compare the string "false" to boolean false; NO_PUBLIC_RW_ACL — rule fails on absent AccessControl but BPA blocks all public access, and adding AccessControl:Private only trades it for cfn-lint W3045 legacy-property, so reverted), the rest (object lock, access logging, replication, versioning, the BucketDeployment role's cloudfront:*Invalidation Resource:'*') are intentional for a rebuildable synth-only demo. Fixed during validation: the BucketDeployment handler's CDK-managed log group (731 d, Retain, from the useCdkManagedLogGroup feature flag) was replaced with an explicit 1-week DESTROY group.
